705113.t: From ἐπιδείκνυμι (epideíknūmi, “to show, display”) + -σις (-sis, verbal noun suffix).

705107.t: From ἐπι- (epĭ-, “upon”) + γνῶσις (gnôsĭs, “inquiry, knowledge”), or from ἐπιγιγνώσκω (epĭgĭgnṓskō) + -σις (-sĭs).

705188.t: From ἐπι- (epĭ-, “on, onto”) + λέγω (légō, “to choose, to say”).

705164.t: Analyzable as By surface analysis, ἐπι- (epĭ-) + κλῆσις (klêsĭs) or as ἐπικαλέω (epĭkăléō) + -σις (-sĭs).

705178.t: From ἐπι- (epi-, on, upon) + κρεμάννυμι (kremánnūmi, “to hang”).

705137.t: From ἐπι- (epi-, “on, upon, atop”) + θέμα (théma, “that which is placed or laid down”).

705187.t: Middle voice from ἐπι- (epi-, “on, upon”) + λανθάνω (lanthánō, “to cause to forget”).
